scope: Eight existing repository clips from four camera recording families in one gym. Diagnose visible painted-line recovery separately from full-court homography acceptance; not an independent venue benchmark.

reference_limitations.source: AI visual annotation of five clearly visible near-half-court line segments per image, frozen before modified detector evaluation
limitations: Approximate image annotations, not surveyed line center coordinates.
Images contain partial courts, lens distortion, glare, moving players and adjacent courts.
Coverage does not measure false positives or confirm court identity.
No physical contact or IN/OUT accuracy is measured.
reference_limitations.negative_region_source: Conservative rectangles wholly above the floor, identified from source images before modified-detector evaluation. Only explicit non-court clutter is measured, not overall precision.
